objective: Define the narrow future execution boundary after the reviewed non-executing observable-ordering helper, without treating helper output, ordering trace, or launcher-start-allowed status as launcher process start, sidecar stage execution, bridge-path compare, timing evidence, broad native option support, arbitrary filelist support, automatic GPU allocation, runtime/ABI change, raw-state equality, direct Verilator sidecar execution, or production throughput.

reason: the previous bridge run was blocked before runtime attempt start because observable ordering before launcher start did not exist
the reviewed helper now provides non-executing ordering trace and launcher-start-allowed status after reviewed metadata validation
a separate boundary is required before any future runtime attempt may start the launcher from structured argv
launcher-start-allowed status is a precondition signal, not launcher process start evidence
bridge-path compare, timing, automatic allocation, arbitrary filelists, and direct Verilator sidecar execution remain later gates
definition_decision.weakest_point: The helper returns launcher-start-allowed status. This boundary must keep that status separate from runtime attempt start and launcher process start; otherwise the project would overclaim bridge execution before the future run gate actually starts the launcher and records sidecar or compare evidence.

failure_class_boundary.verilator_process_parse_failure: the future Verilator-facing invocation rejects or fails before expanded accelerator options are accepted
failure_class_boundary.missing_explicit_sidecar_context: target/template/shape/source context is absent before helper validation or launcher start
failure_class_boundary.source_or_template_authority_failure: reviewed source closure or template authority is absent, mismatched, or replaced by an unreviewed source ref
failure_class_boundary.process_to_launcher_bridge_failure: reviewed helper output cannot be tied to exact process-to-launcher metadata and structured argv
failure_class_boundary.launcher_cli_invocation_failure: the future runtime attempt reaches launcher-start attempt but cannot start or complete launcher invocation safely
failure_class_boundary.sidecar_stage_failure: the launcher starts, but a scoped build or run stage fails before compare
failure_class_boundary.compare_failure: coverage_output_equivalence compare runs and records a mismatch
failure_class_boundary.timing_claim_without_measurement: timing or speedup is claimed without a separate timing gate

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_verilator_process_launcher_bridge_observable_ordering_execution_boundary_gate

whether launcher-start-allowed status remains separate from launcher process start evidence

whether bridge-path compare and timing claims remain blocked until later run gates
